author: /root
purpose: Reconstruct local scalar/Ricci parameters from exposed weak-field response summaries; independently check algebra before any empirical interpretation.
comparison_policy: All data exposed; uncertainty-multiple rectangles only, no fit, no blind test, no joint confidence coverage.
checks: symbolic normalized coupling and its derivative
complete forward and inverse parameter grids
inverse degeneracy at k=1/3 and GR limit
exact null family and nonzero scalar force
fixed-theory G_N first derivative and convergent finite differences
observation-band endpoints and all diagnostic membership rows
finite canonical-distance integral versus elementary expression
scaled steps strictly inside scalar-coordinate domain
deliberate_failures_to_target: differentiate along fixed-k instead of fixed theory
execution: No scientific execution before source and this protocol are frozen. Preserve any original failure; revise separately. Independent agents check only.
finite_difference_step_meaning: Fractions of positive remaining canonical distance, independently obtained by regular integral; closed atanh identity is a control.
finite_difference_error_controls: Central first/second residuals divided by their h^2 leading Taylor terms must differ from1 by <=0.01. Errors must decrease at least20 fold for10 fold smaller h unless below1e-60. Complete exact local derivatives computed before null substitution.
revision_reason: Preserved first run could not find a point beyond the finite canonical endpoint; no original successful run restamped.
